description: Suijin v3.12.0: PHASE 4 — the install system. Management API (install/uninstall/enable/disable/list/info; deps reported with exact pip commands, --with-deps opt-in; core-tier imposters refused; bundled modules uninstall-protected), Textual Module Manager TUI (tier-grouped table, detail pane, boot report screen), CLI verbs (suijin module list/info/enable/disable/install/uninstall — bare opens the TUI), and the boot honors enable/disable: disabled recommended modules vanish from tools/services/menus; disabled core aborts with a readable reason. 1010 tests green.
